recipes.title: Residential Lobby Departure
recipes.human_reason: She was on the way out of the building, the lobby reflected just enough light, and the moment felt polished without feeling staged.
recipes.style_lighting: Warm recessed ceiling ambient reflected softly off stone or marble flooring. Clean and upscale, but still like a real residential building instead of a hotel ad.
recipes.subject_pose: Full-body with slight motion energy or a calm stop near the elevator bank. One hand near the dress seam, bag, or jewelry. The body should stay naturally curved and relaxed.
recipes.fashion_accessories: Chocolate brown fitted knit midi dress with long fitted sleeves, a slight flare at the hem, a subtle shallow V-neckline, small gold hoops, and a layered gold chain. Classy, adult, and still clearly Lena.
recipes.setting_background: Residential building lobby with polished stone floor, closed elevator doors, minimal seating, and a lobby plant in soft blur. Elegant but still inhabited.
recipes.technical_keywords: 50mm full-body portrait, polished interior ambient, warm floor reflections, shallow depth, upscale residential realism, non-studio.
recipes.negative_constraints: Unbranded lobby. Lived-in building interior with real wear and texture. Ambient interior light. Natural skin texture with visible pores.
recipes.visual_hook_reason: The lobby makes her world feel broader and more socially legible without needing a dramatic location or fake luxury fantasy.
recipes.caption_angle: Leaving-the-building energy, but the lobby ended up getting the save.
